levels.title: Arise and Build
levels.verseText: Come, let us rebuild the wall of Jerusalem, that we may no longer be in disgrace.
levels.hintText: Nehemiah looked at the broken wall at night and told the people it was time to start fixing it together.

levels.title: A Mind to Work
levels.verseText: So we built the wall, for the people had a mind to work.
levels.hintText: Everyone worked together, even when the job was hard, because they wanted to finish it.

levels.title: A Great Work
levels.verseText: I am doing a great work, so I cannot come down.
levels.hintText: Enemies tried to distract Nehemiah from finishing the wall, but he stayed focused on the job.

levels.title: The Joy of the Lord
levels.verseText: The joy of the LORD is your strength.
levels.hintText: When the wall was finished, the people celebrated because God had helped them.

levels.title: God Will Give Success
levels.verseText: The God of heaven will give us success.
levels.hintText: Nehemiah trusted that God was with him, even when the work felt impossible.
